moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: The 26th series of the popular reality show 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!' is set to launch from Australia on Monday, November 16th, hosted by Ant & Dec.

angles.name: Launch Hype
angles.copy: Get ready for the jungle! I'm A Celeb is back on Monday, November 16th. Who are you hoping to see in the camp this year?

angles.name: Ant & Dec Angle
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are heading back to Australia! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! kicks off next Monday. What's your favourite Ant & Dec jungle moment?

angles.name: Line-up Speculation
angles.copy: Rumours are swirling about the I'm A Celeb line-up, with names like Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, and Ricky Wilson mentioned. Who's your dream campmate for Monday's launch?

moments.title: England vs Spain: UEFA Nations League
moments.blurb: England faces Spain in a UEFA Nations League match on Sunday, November 15th, a fixture that has even shifted the start date of I'm A Celeb this year.

angles.name: Match Hype
angles.copy: Big game Sunday! England take on Spain in the UEFA Nations League. Can the Three Lions secure a crucial win?

angles.name: I'm A Celeb Link
angles.copy: Football fans, get ready! The England vs Spain Nations League match on Sunday is so big, it's pushed back the I'm A Celeb launch. Priorities, right?

moments.title: Marylebone Village Christmas Lights Switch-On

moments.title: Black Friday Deals Are Starting Early
